patch_description: The current hill climbing only accepts moves that strictly increase the single global minimum area. This creates huge flat plateaus: moving one vertex of the argmin triangle usually doesn't help (another triangle becomes the min), so the search stalls at min_area_normalized ≈ 0.02. Following the recommendation, I modify `_polish` to (a) rank moves by a soft objective — the mean of the k smallest triangle areas — which gives targeted pressure to lift the whole bottom tail, and (b) re-check the true global minimum as the gate for committing a new best configuration. This escapes local traps where improving the bottom-k average is possible but the strict min stays flat, and then periodically locks in true min improvements. I also apply the same soft pressure inside `_anneal` by widening k_bot and biasing vertex selection toward the very worst triangles.
